title: Antelope Boat Rentals
specs: Triumph 192 boats known for durability, stability, and comfort on Lake Powell
Locally owned in Page, Arizona with expert local knowledge of Lake Powell
Valet launch and retrieval service at Antelope Point Marina included (extra fee)
Valid photo ID matching payment method
National Park Pass required to enter Glen Canyon ($35 for 7 days)
Mandatory 20–30 minute orientation at launch ramp
includes: Life jackets for adults and children
Full tank of fuel (refueling not included)
blurb: Renters drive durable, stable Triumph 192 boats on Lake Powell for sightseeing, swimming, tubing, and canyon exploring. Rentals include safety gear, life jackets, anchors, ropes, bumpers, and a full fuel tank. Launch and retrieval are handled by valet service at Antelope Point Marina.
extraNote: $1,000 hold placed at time of rental as damage deposit · Charges may apply for scratches, dents, upholstery damage, bent props, missing or broken equipment · Excessive cleaning fees may apply for above average debris, sand, or bodily fluids · Fuel charge based on exact refueling price plus $20 transportation cost · Full refund or free rebooking if operator cancels due to weather or safety · No refunds for customer cancellations within 48 hours; 25% booking fee nonrefundable · Free rescheduling up to 72 hours before rental; 25% rebooking fee inside 72 hours · Late return fee $150 per hour or $2.50 per minute after 15-minute grace period · Antelope Point Marina, Page, AZ
